digest.component_or_area: automated bug filing and canary alerting infrastructure
propositions: Automated bug filers across three sites (heartbeat alert, binding-drift alert, conflict filer) create duplicate tickets and file on single flakes due to missing deduplication, templating, and abort-on-empty guards.
Heartbeat filer lacks a consecutive-red threshold; it should query workflow run history to ensure at least 2 consecutive failures before filing, using the prior run's conclusion as durable state.
Binding-drift and conflict filers lack stable dedup tags, templated body fields (check name, first-red time, run URL, output tail, workflow path), and empty-detail abort logic.
Accumulation comments lack rate-limiting; filers should write at most one marker-bearing comment per ticket per 24 hours, checking the ticket's own comment history.

Auto-bug-creation sites lack a documented contract specifying rebar create args, exit codes, dedup search command, and REBAR_DETECTED_BY env var convention, causing silent breakage when gate/arg changes occur.
